title: 90-day backtest

intro.draft: Try {name} on every document sent in the last 90 days with the real routing engine, beside the route each one actually took. Nothing is changed.
intro.withdrawal: See how {name} would change the route of the documents sent in the last 90 days, beside the version they actually used. Withdrawing this version means none of these changes happen.

summary: {total, plural, =0 {No documents were sent in this period} one {# document} other {# documents}}
changedCount: {changed, plural, =0 {none changes route} one {# changes route} other {# change route}}
loadTitle: Tasks per person under this version
noChange: No document changes route: this version gives the same result as the one actually used for every document in the period
noDocuments: No documents were sent in the last 90 days, so there is nothing to compare yet. Try again once documents come in.
pending: This period holds {count} documents, so the backtest runs in the background. Press "Look again" in a moment.
stillPending: Not finished yet. Press "Look again" in a moment.
failed: The backtest of {count} documents did not finish. Press "Run the backtest again"; if it still fails, tell your system administrator.

sideErrors.APPROVER_NOT_FOUND: No approver found: the position this rule names is vacant
sideErrors.REVIEWER_NOT_FOUND: No reviewer found: the position this rule names is vacant and has no fallback
sideErrors.NO_HIGHER_AUTHORITY: Nobody has higher authority than the requester
sideErrors.DOA_NOT_CONFIGURED: No DOA rule applies to this document
sideErrors.DOA_AMBIGUOUS: More than one DOA rule applies to this document
sideErrors.SOD_VIOLATION: The approver is the requester and nobody can approve instead
sideErrors.OTHER: The route could not be worked out (code {code})

errors.INPUT: Something was missing. Reload this page and try again.
errors.FORBIDDEN: You may not run the backtest of this version. Only organization admins and this version's approver can.
errors.NOT_FOUND: This version is gone. Reload this page.
errors.STATE: The backtest cannot run now. Reload this page and try again.
errors.UNAUTHENTICATED: Your sign-in has expired. Sign in again and retry.
errors.CONFLICT: This was sent already. Reload this page.
errors.BUSY: Too many requests. Wait a moment and try again.
errors.INTERNAL: Something went wrong. Try again; if it keeps failing, tell your system administrator the code {requestId}.
errors.NO_APPROVER: No approver could be found. Check the DOA in effect.
errors.NO_ANSWER: No answer came back. Check your connection and try again.
errors.FAILED: The backtest did not run. Try again.
errors.RUN_GONE: This result is no longer there. Press "Run the backtest again".
